verdict.rationale: Idempotent retries are a fair question for a billing API like Autumn, but the evidence pack never mentions idempotency keys or safe-retry semantics for any endpoint. The atomic check-and-reserve call is a concurrency feature, not retry deduplication, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
